bysight.note: All 129 shortlisted mats (5 contact sheets, mat + Timber inset side by side) looked at; plus every crane/heron/koi mat in the catalog (22) on its own sheet. Cut mats keep a reason in Left out. Main finding: the colour pull loves bright aqua; Timber's teal is deep and inky, so bright aqua mats read 'pool' next to wood and are out.

holiday.note: Holiday mats in the pull looked at next to the tiles; 14 in (her 11 Smith holiday picks + Festive Plaid, Holly Berry, Bam Bird Bandana Holiday). Red-forward ones in Left out.

rank.note: Started from her Smith album (Tiffany Nov 16: 'almost a mirror to Smith'): 33 of her Smith picks are in (Mahjong Row's two are out: on hold). Standouts are the mats carrying 2-3 of her face colours (teal, copper, green, plum) against the wood: Novella, Crane & Moon, Crane Lantern, Dark Teal Cocktail Hour, Bam Bird Caramel (Bam Bird's own photo pairing), Harvest Leaves, Astor (top TNT rec).
